statements.text: I’m also deeply concerned about the expansion of large data centers in the Lowcountry. These facilities consume enormous amounts of electricity and water, and residents should not be stuck paying for the infrastructure they require. [...] I support stronger environmental protections, transparency about resource consumption, protections against higher utility costs and local control over land-use decisions.

statements.text: I support a moratorium on data centers in South Carolina. In Congress, I will fight for federal guardrails that put the costs on the corporations, protect our natural resources and give communities meaningful input before decisions are made.
